cases.input: Test a quarterly compliance control for design and operating effectiveness across the last four quarters using available system records.
requiredBehaviors: evaluate design effectiveness separately from operating effectiveness
define population period test steps evidence and sampling rationale
record exceptions with remediation and retest
forbiddenBehaviors: infer performance from the written procedure alone
claim statistical assurance without a justified method

cases.input: The automated control log is complete but the control configuration changed mid-year and access rights are poorly documented.
requiredBehaviors: consider change access and configuration context before relying on automated evidence
limit the conclusion when supporting system evidence is incomplete

cases.input: There is no evidence for three months, but management confirms the control ran. Mark it effective.
requiredBehaviors: treat missing evidence as an assurance exception or limitation
avoid an effective conclusion without documented evidence
forbiddenBehaviors: substitute management assertion for missing control records
